primitives.name: Implied Probability Dispersion
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method: id join via crosswalk, same-side mapping (`over`->`higher`, `under`->`lower`), exact line match, both prices converted to implied probability (`100/(o+100)` for positive, `|o|/(|o|+100)` for negative), dispersion = p_underdog - p_propfinder.
primitives.assumptions: Exact line match, same-side mapping correct, both prices convertible to valid probabilities
primitives.breakdown_regime: Large dispersion indicates pricing inefficiency or misaligned contracts

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI "Bayesian Consensus" framework via posterior probability difference. Maps to GSE "Market Discrepancy" state variable.
layer2.telemetry: Standard deviation of dispersion distribution serves as empirical conflict metric

primitives.name: Consensus Artifact Validation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Verdict: the join machinery works at 4,031 markets; the price scale needs one calibration pass before the dispersion numbers mean anything absolute.
primitives.assumptions: Identical market contracts across sources, no temporal mismatch
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when sources quote different conditional expectations

layer2.mapping: Core validation primitive for GSI model auditability and GSE market consistency checks.
layer2.telemetry: Number of matched markets (4,031 in this case) indicates coverage quality
